claims.claim: Interac Corp. was reunited as a single company in 2018 after more than 20 years split into two organizations (Interac Association and Acxsys).
claims.quote: More than 20 years after Interac was divided into two organizations, it was reunited again as Interac Corp.
claims.title: Our History - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: No ownership change since 2020 found on interac.ca; shareholders not named on the site. Interac is bank-owned (not published on the pages read).

claims.claim: Interac is headquartered at 200 Bay Street, Royal Bank Plaza, North Tower, Suite 2400, Toronto.
claims.quote: 200 Bay Street, Royal Bank Plaza, North Tower, Suite 2400, P.O Box 45, Toronto, Ontario M5J 2J1
claims.title: Contact Us - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Interac claims 300+ connected financial institutions and 18.6 million transactions per day across its products.
claims.quote: 18.6M Transactions each day with Interac products
claims.title: Company Overview - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Same page: '300+ Financial institutions connected'; 'more than 6.5 billion Interac Debit transactions' for year ending October 2023.

claims.claim: The business landing page publishes 2024 volumes of 6.6B Interac Debit, 1.4B e-Transfer and 568M verification transactions.
claims.quote: 6.6B Interac Debit Transactions
claims.title: Interac for Business - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also '1.4B Interac e-Transfer Transactions' and '568M Verification and Authentication Transactions'. Differs from company-overview (6.5B, FYE Oct 2023) and year-in-review (7B, FY2025): different fiscal years.

claims.claim: The FY2025 Corporate Year in Review reports 7B Interac Debit, 1.6B e-Transfer and 544M Interac Verified transactions, with 99.96% core-platform availability.
claims.quote: 7B total Interac Debit transactions
claims.title: Corporate Year in Review - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Also '1.6B total Interac e-Transfer transactions', '544M total Interac Verified Services transactions', '99.96%' availability, fraud losses four cents per $100, workforce 'more than 900 employees'.

claims.claim: Interac's brand family comprises Interac Debit, Interac e-Transfer, Interac Verified, Interac Direct (via Konek) and Interac e-Transfer Cards.
claims.quote: Interac introduced Interac Verified, the official name for our verification business arm, recognizing our foray beyond payments.
claims.title: Our History - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Products listed on company-overview: Interac Debit, Interac e-Transfer, Interac Verified, Interac Direct, Interac e-Transfer Cards, transit payments, cash withdrawal.

claims.claim: Interac Debit/ABM participants are Direct Connectors to the Inter-Member Network (IMN) or Indirect Connectors that connect through a Direct Connector.
claims.quote: Connect directly to the Inter-Member Network (IMN) to provide Interac® Debit services and ABM withdrawals services.
claims.title: Network Participants - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Roles named: Issuers, Acquirers, Connection Service Providers (CSPs), Settlement Agents. No participant count and no application steps on the page.

claims.claim: Issuer eligibility on the debit network extends beyond banks to money market mutual funds and insurance companies.
claims.quote: financial institutions who maintain demand accounts and issue debit cards to their clients to access Interac services
claims.title: Network Participants - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Settlement Agents 'settle the financial obligations of other members through the Canadian Payments Association's Automated Clearing Settlement System'.

claims.claim: Interac e-Transfer offers three participation models: Direct Exchange Participant, Indirect Exchange Participant (via a CSP) and Connection Service Provider; applicants email newapplicants@interac.ca.
claims.quote: Each Indirect Exchange Participant must appoint a CSP, and the CSP must be authorized by Interac before connecting.
claims.title: Interac e-Transfer participation - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Eligible: federally regulated banks, CIRO investment dealers + FINTRAC MSBs, RPAA-regulated PSPs + FINTRAC MSBs, cooperative credit societies, foreign bank branches, foreign life insurers, trustees. 'Email newapplicants@interac.ca to request information or initiate the process.' No timelines published.

claims.claim: All e-Transfer participants, direct or indirect, must still establish their own settlement arrangements.
claims.quote: All Participants connecting through any of the above options are still required to establish arrangements for settlement.
claims.title: Interac e-Transfer participation - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Interac publishes wholesale Interac Debit switch fees: $0.013985 per POS transaction rising to $0.014438 on Nov 1, 2026, and $0.015881 per ABM withdrawal.
claims.quote: Interac Debit (Chip & PIN, card contactless): $0.013985 (increasing to $0.014438 effective Nov. 1, 2026)
claims.title: Understanding Fees - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Mobile Service Fee same amounts. eCommerce (Apple Pay/Google Pay): Issuer Switch Fee $0.013985 and 'Acquirer Service Fee: $0.025'.

claims.claim: The switch fee is described as cost-recovery and the only fee Interac charges on Interac Debit; Interac sets but does not receive interchange.
claims.quote: It is an annual, low-cost fee set on a cost recovery basis, and it is the only fee charged by Interac Corp.
claims.title: Understanding Fees - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'While Interac Corp. has a role in setting the interchange fee rate, it does not receive any revenue from this fee.'

claims.claim: Interac Debit contactless interchange is a flat fee by tier: $0.020 low-ticket MCCs, $0.025 for merchants above 20M annual contactless transactions, $0.035 all others, $0.055 for $100.01-$250; ABM interchange is $0.75 flat paid issuer-to-acquirer.
claims.quote: ABM Withdrawals $0.75 flat-fee Per completed cash withdrawal transaction paid by Issuer to Acquirer
claims.title: Understanding Fees - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page also states chip-and-PIN 'Interchange for Interac Debit is currently set at zero.' Interac Debit for eCommerce with Apple Pay/Google Pay: Tier 1 60 bps capped $1.80, Tier 2 57.5 bps, Tier 3 55 bps, Tier 4 $0.35 for tax payments (MCC 9311).

claims.claim: Interac Direct carries 55-70 bps interchange (acquirer to issuer) plus a 10 bps Interac Brand Fee paid to Interac Corp.
claims.quote: Interac Brand Fee 10 Basis Points Per initiated Interac Direct transaction paid by the Acquirer to Interac Corp.
claims.title: Understanding Fees - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Interac e-Transfer wholesale fees are $0.08 per non-on-us and $0.04 per on-us transaction, with published connection fees of $50,000 one-time and $20,000 monthly for a direct connection ($5,000 / $1,500 indirect).
claims.quote: One-time Onboarding Fees $50,000 for a direct connection $5,000 for an indirect connection
claims.title: Understanding Fees - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'Monthly Operating Fees $20,000 for each direct connection $1,500 for each of the first 9 indirect connections $500 for each indirect connection beyond 9'; Business Request Money 35 bps capped $3.50 or $0.35 flat with $2,000 onboarding per qualifying customer; Test Environment Maintenance Fee $150/day; onboarding support $250/hour.

claims.claim: ABM surcharging cannot be restricted by Interac under the Competition Tribunal's Interac Consent Order; POS surcharges are capped at $0.25.
claims.quote: As prescribed by the Interac Consent Order issued by the Competition Tribunal, Interac Corp. may not restrict the levying of a surcharge.
claims.title: Understanding Fees - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'The surcharge fee must be capped at $0.25.' for POS Interac Debit.

claims.claim: Interac abides by the FCAC Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry and runs a merchant complaint process: acknowledgement in five business days, final decision in thirty.
claims.quote: Interac Corp. abides by the Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada
claims.title: FCAC Code of Conduct - Merchant Complaints - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Channels: web form, 416-362-8550, compliance.regulations@interac.ca, mail to Compliance & Enforcement Department, Toronto. FCAC escalation 1-866-461-3222. Interac operating rules themselves are not published on interac.ca.

claims.claim: Merchants accept Interac Debit only through an acquirer; Interac publishes an A-Z acquirer directory split by ABM withdrawals, POS/merchant services and in-app/in-browser payments.
claims.quote: Whether you're looking to get started, find information on fees or have other questions, see below for a complete list of Interac Acquirers.
claims.title: Find an Acquirer - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Named acquirers include RBC, TD, BMO, CIBC, Scotiabank, National Bank, Moneris, Square Canada, Global Payments, Elavon, Adyen, Nuvei, Chase Merchant Services.

claims.claim: ATM deployers ride the Inter-Member Network via an ABM acquirer and may surcharge if disclosed; issuer PIN and funds verification happens at the cardholder's FI.
claims.quote: ABM requests are securely passed through the Interac Inter-Member Network. Your customer's financial institution verifies the PIN and funds before dispensing cash from your ABM.
claims.title: Install an ABM - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: No white-label deployer programme or ATM count published on the page.

claims.claim: The Innovation Hub catalogue for fintechs and developers lists five solutions: Business Request Money API, Standard Identity Verification, Advanced Document Verification, KYC and Interac Direct.
claims.quote: Enhance your payment collection with the Interac e-Transfer Business Request Money API
claims.title: Solutions - Interac Innovation Hub
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: KYC 'Provides a set of personal attributes from either Equifax Single or Dual source methods'. Five products visible logged out.

claims.claim: Developer-portal access requires a request per solution; verification solutions get an account immediately, while payment products need a pre-existing relationship with an issuing FI and Interac review.
claims.quote: Access to Payment network products requires a pre-existing partnership or commercial relationship with an issuing Financial Institution
claims.title: Support - Interac Innovation Hub
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: 'To gain access to the developer portal, you must submit a request for the solution you are interested in'; forms at /request-for-access-form and /collaboration-form/. Playground: 'You can complete a test call in the playground environment in minutes'. API keys generated in portal. No auth scheme, base URLs, SDK languages, webhooks, versioning or rate limits readable logged out.

claims.claim: The public Guides section covers only identity-and-access management of the portal (org creators, admin user management, member add, registration/login), not API reference.
claims.quote: Admin can manage user roles and setup temporary passwords or reset passkeys
claims.title: Guides - Interac Innovation Hub
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Guides at /guide/org-managers/, /guide/user-management/, /guide/add-new-member/, /guide/registration-login-guide/.

claims.claim: The Business Request Money solution page describes a light-weight API for web, mobile and QR-triggered collection but publishes no spec; access is via a request form.
claims.quote: The Interac e-Transfer Business Request Money API is a light-weight API that can be integrated into any business platform
claims.title: Business Request Money - Interac Innovation Hub
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Request Access link: https://innovation.interac.ca/request-access-form/

claims.claim: The Interac Brand Centre (brandcentre.interac.ca) is gated to trademark licensees, sponsors and approved vendors; others apply via licensing@interac.ca.
claims.quote: The Interac Brand Centre is available only to: (i) parties with an existing trademark license agreement or sponsorship agreement with Interac
claims.title: Interac Brand Resource Centre
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Interac's public contact page routes most enquiries to the customer's FI and lists no phone number or hours; specialised mailboxes exist for phishing, community and media.
claims.quote: phishing@interac.ca
claims.title: Contact Us - Interac Corp.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: No SLAs, hours or languages published for partners; e-Transfer onboarding support is billable at $250/hour per fees page.
